title: Accumulated statement work in one interval
method: Synthetic ten-minute population. Calls × mean execution time yields 120, 80 and 20 seconds. The lookup is 54.5% of these groups only. Accumulated execution overlaps under concurrency and is not a CPU measurement.
alt: Accumulated statement work in one interval. Repeated lookup: 120 seconds; Occasional report: 80 seconds; Synchronization: 20 seconds. Illustrative values.
